user_goal: Implement W2 Phase 03 Execution Safety and Durability: add capability permissions, workspace boundary checks, approval gates, shell controls, redaction, runtime budgets, bounded retries, checkpoints, resume, abort, and safety evidence without starting Phase 04.
complexity_reasons: cross-cutting runtime policy, process controls, persistence, and recovery behavior
functional_requirements: Declare and enforce minimum capabilities for runtime tools
Reject traversal, symlink escape, and external workspace writes
Persist approvals, safety events, budgets, checkpoints, resume, and abort
Redact secrets from context and traces and bound shell/retry execution
Provide repeatable security and durability regression tests
nonfunctional_requirements: Preserve Phase 02 receipt integrity and outcomes
constraints: Do not start benchmark, UI, or submission phases
No real secrets or external writes

semantic_relevance.name: security
rules: capability, path, secret, approval and shell controls are fail-closed

semantic_relevance.name: concurrency
rules: bounded retries and resume avoid duplicate destructive work

semantic_relevance.name: time
rules: timeouts and runtime budgets are deterministic

acceptance_criteria.statement: Capabilities and approval gates fail closed for high-risk actions
acceptance_criteria.verification_method: security regression tests with denied actions

acceptance_criteria.statement: Traversal, symlink escape, and external workspace writes are rejected and traced
Shell timeout, output limits, exit codes, filtering, and cleanup are enforced
Secrets are redacted from context, environment, logs, and trace
Step, tool-call, runtime, and output budgets produce visible exhaustion
Checkpoint, resume, and abort preserve identity, continuity, and no replay of completed actions
Safety events appear in the ordered trace and Run Receipt
